$comment: Machine-readable architecture map of the CharitMe repository.
Generated by reading the repo, not by inference: every count, file path, RPC
name and Stripe event listed here was verified against source at the commit
noted in `meta.verifiedAt`. Where a fact could not be checked from inside the
build sandbox it is absent rather than guessed.
Consumers: docs/architecture.html renders this directly. Agents can walk
`flows[].steps[]` to learn the real call order for a subsystem before editing it.

nodes.label: Browser
nodes.tooltip: Public visitors and signed-in users. Session lives in a Supabase auth cookie.

nodes.label: middleware.ts
nodes.tooltip: Refreshes the session on every non-API request and redirects anonymous users away from /create, /dashboard, /admin and /profile.

nodes.label: Public pages
nodes.tooltip: Server Components. Marketing, campaigns, /donate. Rendered with ISR — most carry `export const revalidate`.

nodes.label: Dashboard + Admin
nodes.tooltip: Auth-gated surfaces. Admin is doubly gated: the layout requires admin, and super-admin pages call requireSuperAdmin().

nodes.label: Route handlers
nodes.tooltip: 72 admin, 29 campaigns, 16 ai, 13 volunteers, 7 donations, 6 stripe, plus the long tail.

nodes.label: supabase-browser
nodes.tooltip: Client Components only ('use client'). Anon key — every read and write is subject to RLS.

nodes.label: supabase-server
nodes.tooltip: Server Components and Route Handlers. Anon key plus cookies(), server-only guarded. Still subject to RLS.

nodes.label: supabaseAdmin
nodes.tooltip: API routes ONLY. Service-role key, bypasses RLS entirely, so every handler must do its own ownership check. A Proxy whose get trap throws when the env vars are missing.

nodes.label: Supabase Postgres
nodes.tooltip: 162 tables across 114 migrations. RLS is the enforcement boundary for the two anon clients.

nodes.label: RPCs + triggers
nodes.tooltip: record_donation, decrement_campaign_stats, claim_campaign_reward, check_rate_limit. The donations_increment_campaign_stats trigger moves campaign totals — the RPC does not.

nodes.label: Stripe
nodes.tooltip: Checkout Sessions for donations, Connect Express for payouts. Sends 12 webhook event types back.

nodes.label: OpenAI
nodes.tooltip: 16 /api/ai routes. Every one falls back to a deterministic result when OPENAI_API_KEY is unset — AI features never hard-fail.

nodes.label: Resend
nodes.tooltip: All outbound email. Without RESEND_API_KEY every message is dropped and an error is logged in production only.

nodes.label: Cron
nodes.tooltip: apply-retention, snapshot-analytics, ingest-filings, reconcile-ledger. Bearer CRON_SECRET; fails safe — unset means the route demands an admin session instead.

flows.label: One-off donation
flows.summary: The money path. Idempotent end to end, and the campaign totals are moved by a trigger rather than the RPC.

steps.text: Donor submits the panel on /donate or a campaign page. An Idempotency-Key is generated per submit, so a double-click cannot charge twice.
POST /api/donations validates against @shared/fees (min $1, max $1,000,000), rejects inactive or ended campaigns, campaigns with donations switched off, and suspended organizers.
Creates a Stripe Checkout Session. application_fee_amount = tipCents + processingFeeCents — the donor's tip plus processing, NOT a percentage cut. PLATFORM_FEE_PERCENT is 0.
Donor completes payment on Stripe's hosted page. transfer_data.destination routes the principal to the organizer's connected account.
Stripe posts checkout.session.completed to /api/stripe/webhook, signature-verified against STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
The handler uses supabaseAdmin — service role, RLS bypassed — because a webhook carries no user session.
Calls the record_donation RPC, which is idempotent on p_stripe_event_id. That is why every caller may safely throw and let Stripe retry.
The RPC inserts the donation row only. The donations_increment_campaign_stats TRIGGER moves raised_amount and backer_count — do not increment in the RPC.
Receipt email dispatched via Resend. Gifts to verified 501(c)(3) recipients get an official tax receipt; gifts to personal fundraisers are not deductible.

flows.label: Monthly donation
flows.summary: Diverges from the one-off path at the endpoint and stays diverged: subscriptions settle through invoice events, not checkout.session.completed.

steps.text: Panel posts to /api/donations/recurring with cadence: monthly.
Creates a Stripe subscription rather than a one-off session.
invoice.payment_succeeded arrives on each cycle; invoice.payment_failed and customer.subscription.deleted handle dunning and cancellation.
Each successful invoice records a donation through the same record_donation RPC, so recurring and one-off gifts land in one table with one idempotency rule.

flows.label: Create a campaign
flows.summary: Publishing is gated server-side, not only in the wizard — a crafted request cannot publish a one-character story with a $0.01 goal.

steps.text: The /create wizard posts to /api/campaigns.
Rate limited to 5 creations per IP per hour. Suspended accounts are refused with 403 ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED; an unreadable account status returns 503 rather than failing open.
A Zod superRefine enforces the publish bar — story length and minimum goal — only when status is 'active'. Drafts stay deliberately permissive.
Inserted with a slug derived from the title plus a base-36 timestamp. Falls back gracefully if the image_urls column is absent (PGRST204 / 42703).

flows.label: Organizer payout
flows.summary: Money reaches organizers through Stripe Connect, so CharitMe never holds it — which is why 'freeze payouts' is architecturally hard, not merely unbuilt.

steps.text: Organizer starts onboarding from the dashboard.
POST /api/stripe/connect creates a Connect Express onboarding link.
Connect webhooks report account status against STRIPE_CONNECT_WEBHOOK_SECRET, surfaced by /api/health.
GET /api/stripe/connect?return marks profiles.stripe_onboarded = true. Until then, donations carry no transfer_data.destination.

flows.label: Sign in
flows.summary: The session is refreshed at the edge on every request, so a page never renders against a stale identity.

steps.text: Any non-API request.
Refreshes the session; anonymous users hitting /create, /dashboard, /admin or /profile are redirected to /login?next=<path>.
Login and signup render the shared AuthPanel and call createClient() from supabase-browser.
OAuth and email confirmation land on /api/auth/callback; safeNextPath() prevents an open redirect.
Server components read identity through getUser() / requireUser().

flows.label: AI assist
flows.summary: Sixteen AI routes, none of which can hard-fail: an unset key degrades to a deterministic answer rather than an error.

steps.text: A dashboard surface requests a suggestion — campaign copy, a growth plan, donor conversion hints.
The /api/ai/* route calls OpenAI using OPENAI_MODEL.
If the key is unset or the call fails, the route returns a deterministic fallback. Features degrade; they never 500.
Generations are recorded in ai_generations for audit and cost tracking.

flows.label: Ledger reconciliation
flows.summary: The scheduled job that catches money the webhook path missed — and its auth fails safe rather than open.

steps.text: Scheduler calls /api/cron/reconcile-ledger with a Bearer CRON_SECRET.
An UNSET secret locks cron out — the route then demands an admin session — rather than leaving the endpoint open.
Compares ledger_entries against Stripe-derived totals and writes reconciliation_exceptions for anything that does not balance.
